li.label: a bed for when I was sick
li.description: When I was ill, there was a bed set aside for me and someone looked in on me. It made it easier to bear.

li.label: healroot put by
li.description: There's healroot hanging to dry, enough for the next fever. I feel better about the winter.

li.label: something fresh in the stores
li.description: There's something fresh to eat in the stores again. Even raw, it tastes like a feast day.

li.label: hot tea while I was sick
li.description: When I was sick, someone made sure there was hot tea. It's a small thing, and I won't forget it.

li.label: years turned back
li.description: There's a biosculpter pod in the colony now. I can think about the years ahead without dreading them.

li.label: an evening at the strangers' fire
li.description: I sat at the campers' fire and heard about roads I've never walked. It was good to hear new voices.

li.label: the council sat down together
li.description: I asked for a meeting and we had one. I said my piece, and people listened.

li.label: everyone at one table
li.description: We all sat down together at supper, nobody standing and nobody waiting. It felt like a family meal.

li.label: someone to teach
li.description: I have someone to pass on what I know. It makes the years I spent learning it feel worth something.

li.label: food put by for winter
li.description: There's food in the stores that won't spoil before spring. Whatever happens, we won't starve.

li.label: a voice from outside
li.description: We can talk to the rest of the world now. It feels less lonely out here.

li.label: a bed for our guests
li.description: Visitors who come to us have a proper bed now. I'm proud that we can offer it.

li.label: a fishing spot
li.description: There's a place by the water where I can sit with a line and wait. It's the quietest hour of my day.

li.label: the stars up close
li.description: I spent a night at the telescope looking at things nobody here has seen before. The world feels bigger.

li.label: my tools in their place
li.description: Every tool hangs where I left it now. Work at the bench goes smoothly.

li.label: stone ready to build with
li.description: There's a stack of cut stone waiting. I keep planning what to build with it.

li.label: a drill to go deeper
li.description: We have a deep drill now. Whatever is down there, I'll be the one who finds it.

li.label: the animals penned
li.description: Our animals have a proper pen now. I know where they all are, and they look content.

li.label: a summer evening at the grill
li.description: We cooked over the grill outside on a warm evening, everyone gathered round. That's what summer is for.

li.label: somewhere cool in the heat
li.description: On the worst of the hot days there's somewhere cool to go. I can breathe again.

li.label: a sauna in winter
li.description: There's a sauna to sweat the cold out of me. I come out warm all the way through.

li.label: a soft chair for old bones
li.description: There's a soft chair where I can rest my old bones at the end of the day. It's the best part of my evening.

li.label: a resting place ready
li.description: My resting place is built and waiting. It's a strange thing to say, but it gives me peace.

li.label: a grown-up is teaching me
li.description: One of the grown-ups is teaching me something I love. I'm getting better every day.

li.label: a new animal to look after
li.description: There's a new animal in the colony and I get to help look after it. Best day in a long time.

li.label: new stories to read
li.description: There are new books in the colony, and I'm reading every one. I can't put this one down.

li.label: a real floor at last
li.description: My room has a proper floor now instead of bare ground. It finally feels like a room.

li.label: a scarecrow in the fields
li.description: There's a scarecrow watching over the fields now, and the crops are ours again.
